episode.title: A Walk Through Kyoto
intro: Emma and Nao spend Saturday taking photos around Kyoto. They visit old streets, small temples, and beautiful gardens. Nao shows Emma her favorite places. By the end of the walk, Emma is beginning to feel at home.
エマとナオは土曜日に京都を巡り、写真を撮ります。古い通りや小さなお寺、美しい庭園を訪れ、ナオがお気に入りの場所を案内します。散歩が終わるころ、エマはここでの暮らしになじみ始めていると感じます。
goal: I can talk with a friend about a day out and say what I enjoyed.
友達と外出した日のことを話し、楽しかったことを伝えられる。
episode.warmup: Where would you take a friend who was new to your city?
words: We walked through the old streets.
古い通りを歩きました。
小さなお寺を訪れました。
写真を何枚か撮りました。
庭園は静かで落ち着いていました。
そこが一番お気に入りの場所でした。
ここではくつろいだ気持ちになります。
discussion: Tell your tutor about a day out. Say where you went and one thing you enjoyed. Ask about your tutor's day out too.
外出した日のことを講師に話しましょう。行った場所と楽しかったことを一つ伝え、講師にも尋ねましょう。
episode.followup: Would you like to go there again?

rule: Use past simple for a finished day out. Some verbs change: go → went; take → took.
終わった外出について話すときは過去形を使います。go は went、take は took のように変わる動詞もあります。
examples: We went to a garden and took photos.
庭園に行って写真を撮りました。

rule: Ask: What did you enjoy? Answer: I liked ... because ...
What did you enjoy? で楽しかったことを尋ねます。I liked ... because ... で理由も伝えましょう。
examples: I liked the garden because it was peaceful.
静かで落ち着いていたので、その庭園が気に入りました。

situation: At the end of their walk, Nao and Emma talk about the day. Practice with your tutor.
散歩の終わりにナオとエマが一日を振り返ります。講師と練習しましょう。
dialogue: Nao
Did you enjoy our walk today?
Emma
Yes. We saw many beautiful places.
Nao
Which place did you like best?
Emma
I liked the garden because it was peaceful.
Nao
Did you take many photos there?
Emma
Yes. I took a photo of the trees by the pond.
Nao
Nice. Can I see the photo?
Emma
Of course. What was your favorite part?
Nao
Walking through the old streets with you.
Emma
Thank you for showing me around. I feel at home.
questions: Which place did Emma like best?
What did she take a photo of?
How does Emma feel at the end?

choose: We (went / go) to a garden yesterday.
I (took / take) photos on our walk.
Which place did you (like / liked) best?
I liked it (because / but) it was quiet.
Thank you for (showing / show) me around.
choices: Your friend asks what you enjoyed. Which answer gives a reason?
The garden, because it was peaceful.

situation: You are Emma. You and Nao have just finished a photo walk through Kyoto. Your tutor is Nao.
あなたはエマ役です。ナオと京都で写真散歩を終えたところです。講師はナオ役です。
task: Talk about where you went, what you photographed, and your favorite place. Give a reason. Ask Nao about her favorite part and thank her.
行った場所、撮った写真、お気に入りの場所について話しましょう。理由を伝え、ナオにも楽しかったことを尋ね、感謝を伝えましょう。
lines: Emma, did you enjoy our walk today?
What did you take photos of?
Which place did you like best? Why?
Would you like to visit another place next time?
mission.evidence: Tutor evidence note: Student uses simple past for the day out (went/visited/took), says a favorite place with a reason (because), asks Nao a related question, and thanks her for showing her around.

topics: Where did you go last weekend?
What is your favorite place in your city?
What helps you feel at home in a new place?
Do you like quiet places or busy places?
Who can help a new visitor?
trivia: "Show someone around" means to guide a visitor and introduce places. You can say, "Thanks for showing me around."
show someone around は、訪問者を案内していろいろな場所を紹介するという意味です。案内してもらった後は Thanks for showing me around. とお礼を言えます。
triviaQuestion: What could you say after a friend gives you a tour?
episode.closing: Emma feels more comfortable in Kyoto after the walk with Nao.
